debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Write concise diagnostic messages to the browser console. Disabled by default.

defaultFolder.name: Default NPC folder
defaultFolder.hint: Root Actor folder used when no destination is entered in NPC Button. Leave empty to create NPCs at the Actors root.

maxBatch.name: Maximum batch size
maxBatch.hint: Maximum number of NPC Actors that one generation or import action may create.

ui.intro: Configure NPCs once, then create them locally or use the same intent for an AI-generated Foundry payload.
ui.speciesPlaceholder: Choose a suggestion or type any species
ui.speciesHint: Preset species are suggested, but any custom species can be typed directly here.
ui.seedPlaceholder: Optional reproducible seed for local generation
ui.seedHint: Local generation with the same options and seed reproduces the same generated data.
ui.destinationIntro: Choose where locally generated or AI-imported Actors are created.
ui.destinationHint: Leave blank for the configured default. Choose an existing folder suggestion, or type a new root-folder name.
ui.openLastActorHint: Useful for immediately reviewing the result after a local generation or AI import.
ui.aiIntro: Copy a strict prompt into any AI conversation, copy its JSON reply, then import that reply into the destination above.
ui.singleAiObject: Use a single JSON object when Count is 1
ui.singleAiObjectHint: Off by default. Otherwise the prompt always requests a JSON array, including for a single NPC.
ui.manualPastePlaceholder: Paste the JSON reply here only if your browser blocks clipboard reading.

help.title: NPC Button Help
help.generationBody: The dashboard uses the same intent for deterministic local generation and the AI prompt workflow.
help.count: Type any allowed number directly, or use the common 1, 3, 5, and 10 shortcuts.
help.role: Defines the NPC's practical function and biases local ability scores and durability.
help.tier: Controls the overall competence and challenge of locally generated NPCs.
help.species: Choose a suggested species or simply type a custom one in the same field; no separate Custom mode is required.
help.seed: Only affects deterministic local generation. It is intentionally not required for AI generation.
help.destination: Blank uses the configured default. An existing suggestion targets that folder. Any other text creates or reuses a root Actor folder of that name.
help.namingBody: Naming styles are deliberately broad tonal palettes rather than historical or linguistic claims.
help.aiBody: The module does not call an AI service itself. It creates a strict portable prompt and validates the returned Foundry Actor JSON before importing it.
help.aiStep1: Configure Count, Role, Tier, Species, Naming style, and Destination.
help.aiStep2: Click Copy prompt and paste the prompt into an AI conversation.
help.aiStep3: Copy the AI's JSON-only reply to your clipboard.
help.aiStep4: Return to Foundry and click Import NPC. The current destination is applied locally.
help.aiValidation: The importer accepts the stable D&D 5e NPC Actor core used by this release and rejects malformed or count-mismatched payloads before creating Actors.

notifications.gmOnly: Only a Game Master can create NPCs with Runyth NPC Button.
notifications.promptCopied: AI NPC prompt copied to the clipboard.

errors.clipboardWrite: Clipboard writing is not available in this client.
errors.clipboardRead: Clipboard reading is not available or was blocked by the browser.
errors.manualPasteFallback: Open the manual-paste section, paste the AI JSON there, and click Import NPC again.
